questions.question: Predictability in the cloud is usually described in which TWO areas?

options.why: Physical security relates to the security benefit.
Licensing is not one of the two predictability areas.

questions.explanation: Microsoft describes performance predictability and cost predictability.

questions.question: Which tool helps you estimate the monthly cost of Azure services before you deploy them?

options.why: Arc extends Azure management to other environments.

questions.explanation: The pricing calculator estimates costs for planned resources.

questions.question: Autoscaling and load balancing mainly contribute to which kind of predictability?

options.why: Correct. They keep the user experience consistent under load.
They affect cost, but their main purpose here is consistent performance.
This is not one of the predictability categories.
This is not one of the predictability categories.

questions.explanation: Autoscaling, load balancing and HA support performance predictability.

questions.scenario: Finance wants to be alerted when a department's Azure spending is forecast to exceed its monthly limit.
questions.question: What should you configure?

options.text: A budget with alerts in Microsoft Cost Management

options.why: Locks prevent deletion or changes, not overspending.
Networking is unrelated to cost alerts.

questions.explanation: Cost Management budgets can alert on actual and forecast spend, supporting cost predictability.
